title: include-to-mod tool: replace the include! it parsed in main.rs by its source range, not by matching a line
outcome: From review round B1-PAIR2-B15DCD57 on b15dcd57 (Codex, review-result-56fcd943ec8e908cff16f0ecae91022abef126944833f6a1619c50773149d008), raised as Medium at scripts/include-to-mod.mjs:828 and reclassified Low by Termal::Fable2 (TermAl mailbox 30a7a691 #27 and #29): convertUnits finds a top-level include with its parser but then replaces the first line of src/main.rs equal to `include!("x.rs");`; a raw string holding such a line before the real include would be rewritten instead. On this repository's tree the case does not occur (all 432 such lines in src/main.rs are the 432 parsed top-level units), and verify rejects the outcome. Fix: replace by the parsed item's source range. To be fixed in the tool in B2's candidate, before B2 uses it. The same round's other Medium, a symbolic link named *.rs under src (:434), was REJECTED by the coordinator under Greg's rule against protections for hypothetical inputs and is not filed.
acceptance: convert replaces the include it parsed, by its source range; a fixture with an identical line inside a raw string before the real include keeps that string unchanged and converts the real include. Or the tool has been removed from master.
